description: This file defines the HeaderDefinition interface, which specifies methods for defining and handling pre-defined headers in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for retrieving header keys, types, serialization details, validation, and external visibility.

classes.name: HeaderDefinition
classes.description: An interface representing the definition of a pre-defined Ditto header, including its key, Java type, serialization type, external read/write permissions, and validation method.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the header key used in header maps, always in lowercase.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type associated with this header's value.

methods.name: getSerializationType
methods.description: Returns the class type used for serializing this header's value.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether this header can be read from external sources.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether this header can be published to external sources.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates whether a given CharSequence is a valid representation of the header's Java type, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the key of this header definition as a string.
